SEARCH
Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.onchain

Interface BlockchainClient

All Known Implementing Classes:
BitcoinCoreRpcClient
public interface BlockchainClient
Boundary for Bitcoin Core RPC operations used by KFE wallet, deposit, and transaction workflows. Default methods normalize Bitcoin Core's differing response shapes into satoshi-based values.

    • getHotWalletBalance

      default long getHotWalletBalance()
      Reads the hot wallet balance using modern getbalances and legacy fallback RPCs. Provider errors and unparseable results map to zero for monitoring callers.
      Returns:

    • estimateSmartFee

      default BlockchainClient.FeeRates estimateSmartFee(int fastBlocks, int halfHourBlocks, int hourBlocks)
      Estimates three fee-rate horizons, using fixed fallbacks when a target is unavailable.
      Parameters:
      fastBlocks - target blocks for the fast estimate
      halfHourBlocks - target blocks for the medium estimate
      hourBlocks - target blocks for the conservative estimate
      Returns:
      normalized rates, each at least one sat/vB

    • getConfirmedBalanceForAddress

      default long getConfirmedBalanceForAddress(String address)
      Scans the UTXO set for confirmed outputs associated with one address descriptor.

      Scan failures propagate: an incomplete scan (e.g. Core "scan already in progress") must never be reported as an empty balance.

      Parameters:
      address - Bitcoin address to scan
      Returns:
      confirmed balance in satoshis, or zero for blank input
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - when the scan fails or does not complete

    • getConfirmedBalanceForXpub

      default long getConfirmedBalanceForXpub(String xpub, int range, boolean includeChangeBranch)
      Scans an extended public key's receive branch and optionally its change branch.
      Parameters:
      xpub - extended public key used to construct wpkh descriptors
      range - inclusive derivation scan range, normalized to at least one
      includeChangeBranch - whether to include branch /1/* in addition to /0/*
      Returns:
      sum of confirmed outputs for the selected branches in satoshis

    • getConfirmedBalanceForDescriptor

      default long getConfirmedBalanceForDescriptor(String descriptor, int range)
      Confirmed UTXO-set balance for an output descriptor (e.g. wpkh(xpub/0/*)). Uses scantxoutset — independent of wallet-internal ledger.

    • getUnspentBalanceForAddresses

      default long getUnspentBalanceForAddresses(List<String> addresses)
      Sum of unspent outputs for specific addresses (includes 0-conf when Core reports them). Always filter by address set — never sum the entire shared Core wallet.

    • getUnspentOutputs

      default List<BlockchainClient.AddressUtxo> getUnspentOutputs(String address)
      Lists unspent outputs returned by Core's imported-wallet view for one address. Only outputs with a valid transaction ID, output index, and positive value are retained.
      Parameters:
      address - address used to restrict listunspent
      Returns:
      immutable normalized UTXO list, or an empty list for invalid input/provider failure

    • getUnspentOutputsFromScan

      default List<BlockchainClient.AddressUtxo> getUnspentOutputsFromScan(String descriptorOrAddr, int range)
      Unspents from the UTXO set via scantxoutset — works without Core wallet import. Prefer this for watch-only / cold addresses.

    • getBlockTipHeight

      default long getBlockTipHeight()
      Returns Core's current best block height for confirmation calculations.
      Returns:
      nonnegative chain tip height, or zero when unavailable

    • isOutpointUnspentIncludingMempool

      default boolean isOutpointUnspentIncludingMempool(String txid, int vout)
      True if the outpoint is still unspent considering the mempool (gettxout with include_mempool=true). scantxoutset ignores mempool spends — Electrum does not.

      Important: when spent, Core returns JSON "result": null. Some unwrap helpers return the whole RPC envelope in that case — we must treat that as spent.

    • findSpendingTxid

      default String findSpendingTxid(String txid, int vout)
      Mempool (or chain) txid that spends the given outpoint, if known. Uses Bitcoin Core gettxspendingprevout when available.

    • getUnspentOutputsMerged

      default List<BlockchainClient.AddressUtxo> getUnspentOutputsMerged(String address)
      Merge listunspent + scantxoutset for an address (dedupe by txid:vout, keep max confs).
